## Page 26

Strategic growth for specialized and high -intensity treatment at KIH Vientiane
Kasemrad International Hospital Vientiane plans to launch three high -complexity specialized centers in 2026. These centers 
aim to address the significant shortage of specialized healthcare providers in Laos and meet the growing local demand .  
Kidney Transplant Center
The hospital has officially been licensed to provide 
kidney transplant services in Laos, utilizing a team 
of highly specialized Thai doctors and nurses. 
Currently, the program is actively scheduling cases 
for both Lao and international patients.
Aesthetic Center
 Comprehensive Breast Cancer Center
The hospital launched Aesthetic Center in 
Feb 2026, specializing facelift analysis and design 
by Thai specialized doctors. The center’s programs 
include rhinoplasty, full -incision double eyelid 
surgery and advanced eyelid contouring etc.
The hospital launched Breast Cancer Center 
in Mar 2026, offers comprehensive care from 
screening, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation   
by Thai specialists, the center adheres to international 
standard and serves as a national referral hub.
